note: Marked with concord + le + nosi/esi/bosi depending on who: ke le nosi = I'm alone, o le esi = he/she alone, ba le bosi = they alone.
Literally "close the mouth" — the desk dictionary's collocation for telling someone to shut up.
Alternate form the desk dictionary gives alongside "moma molomo" for the same meaning.
Takes the adjective concord: o montlê = she/he is pretty, mosadi yo montlê = a pretty woman.
Matumo p.629 (English–Setswana section): "save v.t., boloka". Corroborated elsewhere in the same dictionary: "preserve ... or save, boloka" and "spare v.T., save, boloka".
